items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: However, Ella was working with Shadow Wilson; Jimmy Wood on bass, a trio -- and John Lewis was playing piano. They were the four -- the Maldez Quartet. She'd work 30 minutes, we'd work 30 minutes.

ctx.x: Pops. Oh, boy, Chick Webb with Ella.
